name: Finding Really Big Palindromes (decimal-binary palindrome search)

mentions.name: Finding Really Big Palindromes (decimal-binary palindrome search)
mentions.description: A computational search for numbers that are palindromes in both decimal and binary representations. The search fixes the least and most significant decimal digits incrementally and prunes unfeasible subtrees using a new lookup table approach: a table of size 5^n records how many middle bits are needed to achieve a given remainder mod 5^n, allowing branches to be pruned when the required bits exceed the unknown bits. The project also includes engineering optimizations such as more efficient tables and CUDA porting.
